storage.format: Godot var_to_str of the dict below

options.label: window_size
options.effect: 0 = exclusive fullscreen; n = window of 480n x 270n, centred. Choices go up to the first multiple >= the screen size.

options.label: screen_shake
options.effect: Globals.screenshake_intensity = value / 100; multiplies camera shake magnitude (3 px)

options.label: crt_effect
options.effect: on: CRT overlay shown, glow_intensity 1.8; off: CRT hidden, glow_intensity 0.9

options.label: transition_color
options.effect: scene transition wipe tinted MyColors.WHITE (#dcdcdc) or #8f8f8f

options.label: flashing_fx
options.effect: Globals.flashing = (value == 0); controls the white flash on enemy hits and kill impacts

options.label: color_palette
options.effect: skill node outlines: default yellow/green/red, alternate violet/green/dark red

notes: Sliders are Godot HSlider with default range 0-100, step 1; the current value is shown to the right (res://Scenes/Popups/Options/OptionSlider.tscn).
The options popup is reachable from the main menu 'options' button and from the in-shop Escape menu (main menu / options / back) (res://Scripts/Popups/GameMenu.gd).
